page.overview:
Who is Angry Audience Member?

The angry audience member is a man who was underwhelmed by Krusty the Clown's performance at Mr. Burns' Casino. When Krusty said that the audience was the worst one he had seen, the angry audience member responded that he was the worst comedian they had ever seen. When Krusty threatened to simply stand around doing nothing, he replied that that was okay with them.
